surf_collections_strings: hash rows added 2026-11-16 (SF-1 dth_*, SF-2 dec_*)

Rows dth_* come from the native Datetime, Time and Date hashCode capture and
rows dec_* from the Decimal hashCode capture. Both ran in scratch orgs at API
62.0 and 67.0, two repeats each; the repeats agree. Every outcome is the
unmodified test-result message (or the compile problem, or the queried log
payload) from raw/. The cases are Class.method in cases.tsv; the harness runs
each captured method alone.

Source restorations: the capture scrubbed the DthTz user emails and usernames
to a placeholder; they are synthetic example.invalid addresses here. The Dec
capture parked anonymous payloads in a Dec_Log__c record; the anonymous
sources print the same payload with System.debug. The Dec_Hash_Access
permission set was an environment step in the capture (assigned to the
running user, glade.yml replays it); Dth_Probe_Access is assigned only to the
runAs users, as in the capture, so the API 67.0 DthField insert is the native
"fields being inaccessible" DmlException.

Volatile values: the Datetime rows that read an inserted record's CreatedDate
(the S, SOQL, FM and FR tails) hold the clock. The harness masks those tails
after checking that each hash is Long.hashCode(ms) XOR 577755.

Fixes these rows drove: Julian civil dates before 1582-10-15 in the Datetime
builders; real offset history for America/Los_Angeles, Asia/Kolkata and
Australia/Adelaide before 2008; the 1700-01-01..4000-12-31 DateTime field
range on insert; List<Decimal> == by scale; Percent and Number integer-part
overflow on insert with the API 62 and API 67 wording; Time.getTime and
Date.getTime as compile errors. hashCode itself already matched.

Not observed, so base behavior: Datetime hash under another user locale
(runAs with a different locale, region-less locales, IS, MV, IR, IL, NL, TR,
MX), and Date and Time hashes under de_DE. The capture used en_US users in
four time zones only. The cross-type direct hash grid for Double, Long and
Integer covers 1.5d, 1 and 1 only. DecHashWrap did not compile natively and
has no row. Currency overflow, rounding-edge overflow, Julian readers
(yearGmt and formatGmt of a pre-cutover instant), valueOf(String) local and
other zones' history are unobserved.
